cases.problem: A database of perfect signals, emails nobody answers
cases.problemDetail: Every rejected trademark filing is a company with a real legal urgency. They have the database. But the emails their agency sends are generic, without mentioning the specific rejection or the concrete risk. Result: almost zero replies, despite having the clearest intent signal there is.
cases.solution: RevCognition takes that case base as context, writes a message that mentions each company's specific rejection, and leaves it ready for your five-minute daily review.

cases.problem: You prospect through your personal network. When you're busy, everything stops
cases.problemDetail: One person handles everything. They know there's a market, they know they should prospect more. But prospecting always gets pushed to whenever there's time, which never comes. There's no system, just sporadic calls to contacts they already know.
cases.solution: RevCognition identifies companies in the sector that match the ideal customer profile, enriches them, and writes them contextualized messages. The system keeps running even while the founder is with a client.

founder.paragraph1: I've spent twenty years working in marketing automation, watching up close how large companies handle their outbound. And also the tools that existed for everyone else.
founder.paragraph2: Most of them ask you to be technical, to write the messages yourself, to manage sequences by hand, or to blindly trust an agency that doesn't understand your business. Neither option was acceptable for a founder with little time and a lot to prove.

producto.metaTitle: Product — RevCognition | Cold outreach, start to finish
producto.metaDescription: Everything RevCognition does: set up in one session, a five-minute daily review, messages written for each prospect, your own domain warmed up patiently, and replies sorted automatically.

hero.heading2: from the first session to the first yes.
hero.subtitle: RevCognition sets up your cold outreach end to end and keeps it running, day after day. Here's what happens under the hood, no jargon.

setup.title: From your website to an active campaign, in one session.
setup.intro: Setting up cold outreach from scratch — domain, mailboxes, sequence, messages — usually takes weeks and several tools. Here it's a single guided session, start to finish.

depth.title: An assistant that gets your account ready to send
depth.body: You paste your website URL and the system drafts a first commercial profile: who you're targeting, what sets you apart, and your tone. You review it, choose a dedicated domain, set up your senders and your booking link, and once you're done the domain enters warm-up. No agencies, no weeks of setup.

depth.title: Your own, authenticated email domain
depth.body: You choose a dedicated domain for your outreach. The system authenticates it (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and builds its reputation from zero, so it never touches your main inbox or depends on a shared IP.

oneLiners.title: Editable commercial profile
oneLiners.body: Correct what the AI understood about your business. Your judgment guides every email, and changes apply to the next batch of contacts.

oneLiners.title: Senders with a real identity
oneLiners.body: Your senders, with real names and titles, protected so they don't damage the domain's reputation.

diaADia.title: Five minutes a day. The rest happens on its own.
diaADia.intro: Human judgment stays at the center: nothing goes out without your approval, but the review is a short daily session, not constant configuration.

depth.title: You approve what goes out, and only that
depth.body: In the Approval Center you see every email already drafted — subject and body, with name, company, and address — before it's sent. Edit the text if you want, expand the full follow-up sequence, mark the ones you approve, and discard the rest. Once you trust the system, you can turn off approval and let sends go out on their own.

oneLiners.title: An honest dashboard
oneLiners.body: Real numbers, not decorative charts: emails sent, replies, and reply rate for your last 30 days.

oneLiners.title: Your lists, with a clear status
oneLiners.body: Contact lists, grouped by file and date, showing what's been processed and what's left.

oneLiners.title: Bring your own contacts
oneLiners.body: A CSV and your contacts enter the same personalization and sending flow as automatic sourcing.

oneLiners.title: You control the settings
oneLiners.body: When you send, how we notify you (email and Telegram), and how your campaign behaves — no ticket needed for every change.

oneLiners.title: You pay per prospect worked
oneLiners.body: Not per seat, not a subscription. Top up credits whenever you want, securely with Stripe.

motor.title: Finds, verifies, and writes. For every prospect.
motor.intro: Finding good target companies is the slowest part of prospecting. The system does it continuously, and for every contact it writes a message built for them.

depth.title: A message written from scratch, not a template
depth.body: Using your commercial profile and the real context of each company, the system drafts a full sequence per contact — opener, follow-up, new angle, and closer. Every email is generated in the language that matches the company's location, so it reads like something handwritten, not a filled-in template.

depth.title: When there's a signal, the message uses it
depth.body: The system also watches for recent activity signals at the target company, like a new hire. When one appears, the message can build on it — for example, if the company is expanding its sales team — to land at the moment it matters most.

oneLiners.title: Companies that match your ICP
oneLiners.body: Finds the companies that match your ideal customer — sector, location, and size — and rules out the ones that don't.

oneLiners.title: Contacts with a verified email
oneLiners.body: The right people at each company, with the email address verified before writing.

entregabilidad.title: Reaching the inbox, and knowing what to do next.
entregabilidad.intro: Cold sending from a new or shared domain ends up in spam. A dedicated domain, warmed up carefully, protects your reputation — and when replies come in, each one gets handled the way it deserves.

depth.title: Real warm-up, not a switch
depth.body: The domain starts with a few emails a day and ramps up the volume gradually — from a range of 4 to 16 a day in the first week to a full volume of 50 by the fourth. The dashboard always shows the warm-up day and the current volume.

depth.title: Every reply, read and classified
depth.body: Interested, not interested, hostile, or out of office: the intent is detected automatically. If there's interest, the sequence pauses and you get the reply instantly by email and Telegram to pick up the conversation yourself; your Cal.com link travels in every email, so the prospect can also book directly from there. A temporary absence pauses and resumes after a few days; a hostile reply closes the thread for good.

oneLiners.title: From reply to meeting
oneLiners.body: When someone replies with interest, the sequence pauses and we notify you instantly by email and Telegram; your Cal.com link travels in every email, so they can also book directly from there.

oneLiners.title: Opt-outs and compliance by default
oneLiners.body: Every email includes an unsubscribe option, and whoever uses it never receives anything again, across any of your campaigns.

faq.heading: What people usually ask before signing up.

items.q: Will I end up in spam?
items.a: It's the first thing we take care of. You send from your own, dedicated domain — not a shared one — and its reputation warms up gradually over the first four weeks, until it reaches full sending volume. On top of that, every email address is verified before writing, so bounces stay low and your messages land in the inbox.

items.q: How much control do I have?
items.a: As much as you want. Every email is prepared but doesn't go out until you approve it — a review of about five minutes a day — and you can edit the text before sending. If you'd rather delegate, you turn off approval and sends go out on their own. The commercial profile that guides every message is yours to adjust whenever you want.

items.q: What language does it write in?
items.a: The language that matches each prospect's location, with English as the default. It's not necessarily your own language: if you write to a company in France, the message goes out in French; to one in Germany, in German. The goal is for every recipient to read the email in their own language.

Every reply is read and classified automatically: interested, not interested, hostile, or out of office. If there's interest, the sequence pauses instantly and you get the reply by email and Telegram to pick it up yourself; your Cal.com link travels in every email sent, so the prospect can also book directly from there. If there's no interest or the reply is hostile, the thread is closed carefully and never contacted again.

An initial setup fee of €50 to get the account ready, then send packs starting at €100 (100 sends), with volume discounts: 600 sends for €500 and 1,300 for €1,000. Prices exclude tax: applicable VAT is added on the invoice based on your company's country. A credit is consumed on the first send to a new prospect; follow-ups in that same sequence don't cost extra credits. No commitment, and credits never expire.

items.q: Does it work in my industry or country?
items.a: The system searches continuously across specialized partner databases: for a single ideal customer profile — sector, location, and size — there can be more than 400,000 candidate companies. And every email arrives in the language that matches the recipient's country, so coverage doesn't depend on the language you speak.

items.q: Where do the contact details come from?
items.a: Contacts come from partner databases specialized in professional information. Before writing, every email address is verified to keep bounces low, and every email includes an opt-out option: whoever unsubscribes never receives anything again, in compliance with regulations.

privacy.metaDescription: How we handle your data at RevCognition: what we collect, why, for how long, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.heading: We treat your data the way we'd want ours treated.
privacy.intro: Plain-language summary. If you need the full legal version or want to exercise any of your rights, write to us at <email>olivier.serres@revcognition.com</email>.

sections.heading: Who is the data controller
sections.body: RevCognition (Olivier Serres). Contact: <email>olivier.serres@revcognition.com</email>. Based in Barcelona, Spain.

sections.heading: What data we collect and why
sections.intro: Only what you voluntarily give us, and always for a specific purpose:

items.label: Product sign-up and onboarding
items.body: (account data, your website URL, product description, ICP configuration): to build your Company Brain and run your campaigns. This data lives on <appLink>app.revcognition.com</appLink>, not on this website.

items.label: Payment data
items.body: (processed by Stripe, not stored by us): to process payment for packs purchased from the app.

items.label: Business contact data
items.body: collected during prospecting: processed on the basis of legitimate interest in B2B communications, always with an immediate opt-out option on every message sent.

sections.heading: Who has access to your data
sections.body: Strictly operational data processors: Stripe (payment processing), Resend (transactional email delivery), cloud infrastructure providers (Vercel or equivalent). We do not sell data to third parties. We do not use it to train general-purpose models. We do not share it with advertisers.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: The minimum necessary. Analysis requests are archived for 12 months so we can respond to any follow-up questions. Tax data associated with payments is kept for the legally required accounting period. Business prospecting data is deleted upon the data subject's request, or after 14 days of no interaction if there is no subsequent contractual basis.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction, and portability. Exercising any of them is as simple as writing to <email>olivier.serres@revcognition.com</email>. We respond within 30 days. If you believe we haven't handled it properly, you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (<aepd>aepd.es</aepd>).

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website does not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics. Only cookies strictly necessary for operation (those Stripe may set during the payment process).

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we make substantial updates to this policy, we will notify by email anyone with an active relationship with us. Last updated: May 2026.
